notes.subject: עירים/עירים
notes.rationale: Consonants identical: עֲיָרִים (ass-colts) le עָרִים (cities) — pheti e tsamaisa phapang ena; diphalane le metse, mme bothata bo timetse Sesothong.

notes.subject: עירים
notes.rationale: Ba fetoleli ba ngata ba bala 'metse' ka bobedi; lemma ya pele e bolela 'diphalana tsa phalla', ka mokgwa wa baahi ba nang le maatla.

notes.subject: להם להם
notes.rationale: Poeletso ya 'ya bona / ho eona' — e hlahisitse eng? e hlophisitse lethathamo la mashome a mararo; Sesotho se boloka palelo.

notes.subject: mashome a mararo
notes.rationale: Palo e hlakileng: bana ba 30, diphalane tse 30, metse e 30 — palo ya bo-(ya ntwa) ya moahloli.

translation: Mme ba ne a na le bana ba bang mashome a mararo, ba namelang ho diphalane tse mashome a mararo; mme metse e mashome a mararo ⟨e ne e le⟩ ya bona; ho eona ho bitswa Havota Yaire ho fihlela lehono lena, eo e leng sebakeng sa Gileade.

tokens.gloss: mme metse e mashome a mararo
